name: GBrain
summary: Garry Tan's open-source agent brain: shared memory with sources, corrections and a knowledge graph, served to Claude, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes and others over MCP.
description: GBrain stores explicit facts with provenance, supports corrections and withdrawal, and makes the same memory available across agents. Start keyless with keyword retrieval, then add semantic search, a cited synthesis layer (answers with an explicit note on what the brain doesn't know), a typed knowledge graph and background enrichment/consolidation jobs. Connects to coding agents and personal agents over MCP; `gbrain mcp expose` publishes a local brain on a Tailscale tailnet (with `--funnel` for cloud agents). Install requires Bun ≥1.4 via `bun install -g github:garrytan/gbrain`; the README warns that the npm package named `gbrain` is unrelated. A hosted team version is offered at gbrain.io. Ships llms.txt, llms-full.txt and AGENTS.md for agents.

agent_access.notes: Local brains need no key; remote/hosted brains use OAuth or a private machine connection (see docs/guides/hosted-harness-access.md). Hosted option: https://gbrain.io
